name: id
description: unique row identifier for the field definition

name: section
description: groups related fields together in the UI or blueprint
options: Organization, Project, Team, Client, Facility, Carrier, Items, Inspection, Damages, Discharge, Time Log, Custom

name: label
description: human-readable field label

name: path
description: unique field path / logical field identifier

name: type
description: actual stored value type
options: string, number, boolean, date, datetime, enum, object, array, file, image, richtext

name: input
description: UI control used to capture or edit the value
options: text, textarea, select, multiselect, date, datetime, number, email, tel, url, file, image, checkbox, radio, repeater, richtext, hidden

name: options
description: If "select" or "multiselect" is chosen from input list, these options are what can be used

name: source
description: where the value comes from
options: user, system, prefilled, derived, template, external

name: editable
description: whether the user can change the value

name: required
description: whether the value must exist for the record to be valid

name: repeatable
description: whether the field is single-value or multi-value

name: value
description: initial value used when creating a new record

name: placeholder
description: form hint text shown before input

name: validation
description: validation rules like min, max, pattern, or format
options: required, min, max, minLength, maxLength, pattern, email, url, phone, date

name: visibility
description: whether the field is shown, hidden, or conditional. Sometimes hidden fields data/value can be used in output/preview pages or other dervived data

name: outputToPages
description: what pages the field is consumed in output/rendering
options: Cover, Table of Contents, Introduction, Project Report, Personnel in Attendance, Cargo Description, Cargo Condition Inspection, Time Log, Cargo Operations, Cargo Damages, Cargo Storage, Cargo Trailer Securement, Ships Particulars, Ships Certifications, Barge Information, Lifting Plan, Lifting Gear, Stowage Plan, Post-Discharge Inspection, Disclaimer

name: outputToPageSection
description: what page sections the field is consumed in output/rendering

name: example
description: sample value to clarify intent

name: reference
description: reference id's that this data field depends on

name: notes
description: implementation notes, edge cases, or extra context
